scenario_text: A capacitor charged to an initial voltage is connected across a resistor, allowing stored charge to drain through the circuit. The rate at which charge leaves the capacitor is proportional to the instantaneous voltage across it. We follow the voltage on the capacitor as it relaxes toward zero. The resistance and capacitance jointly set the relaxation timescale.
